svg.title: Standard BPE vs Combinatorial BPE on prose, code and Chinese
svg.desc: The same 32k-row budget: an English sentence, a code snippet and Chinese text need far fewer combinatorial tokens; Traditional and Simplified Chinese map to identical cores.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: One tokenizer for prose, code and Chinese (both with 32,768 embedding rows)

svg.text: · = space, ↵ = newline. Cores are stored case-folded (and in Simplified for Chinese); identifiers are split at case changes (get|User|Name).
